title: ORion Alma New GEneration Survey (ORANGES). I. Dust continuum and free-free emission of OMC-2/3 filament protostars
question: Are the small-scale dust properties and evolutionary status of solar-type protostars in the OMC-2/3 filament affected by nearby HII regions and UV illumination?

data.bands: Band 6 (~250 GHz, 246.2 GHz); archival 333 GHz ALMA and 32.9 GHz VLA

what.value: 333 GHz and 32.9 GHz cleaned images (robust=2) from Harvard Dataverse

evidence.quote: We used the *robust*=2 (equivalent to natural weighting) cleaned images, for both the ALMA and the VLA data.

what.value: Deconvolved source sizes for sources with point-source or unsatisfactory fits

evidence.quote: We thus used the deconvolved sizes given in (cite: tobin2020).

what.value: HOPS Lbol, Tbol, Menv and classifications

evidence.loc: 3.3 Previous continuum studies on the sample sources
evidence.quote: HOPS provided estimates of the sources evolutionary classification based on their bolometric luminosity, $L_{\text{bol}}$

recipe.goal: Fit source sizes and measure flux densities
recipe.method: uv-plane fit with point source or 2D Gaussian; size convolved with each beam, flux measured in image plane in that ellipse
key_parameters: theta_obs = sqrt(theta_beam^2 + theta_source^2); 10% calibration error in flux

recipe.goal: Derive beta and T_SED, tau, N_H2, mass, free-free fraction
recipe.method: SED method: F=B(Td)(1-exp(-tau))Omega with beta from flux ratios for Td 10-200 K; free-free identified when beta_333-246.2 exceeds beta with 32.9 GHz
key_parameters: beta constrained to 0-2 to bound T_SED
assumptions: mu=2.8, dust-to-gas R=0.01, kappa0=0.9 cm2/g at 230 GHz, d=393 pc, no free-free at 246.2/333 GHz

recipe.goal: Compute Trad and compare with Tbol
recipe.method: Trad = 101 K (Lbol/10Lsun)^1/4 (r/50 au)^-1/2 for single sources

recipe.goal: Reassess evolutionary classification and test environment dependence
recipe.method: Combine beta, Td/Tbol, outflow, radio continuum criteria; Pearson correlations vs filament position

evidence.quote: In total, we detected 28 sources, of which 18 are located inside the primary beam
We clearly found evidence of free-free emission at 32.9 GHz towards 5 out of 16 sources
The majority of the sources (9/16) have a dust emissivity spectral index $< 1$.
the derived free-free emission ranges between 47% and 100%
the derived (envelope + disk) masses range between $2\times10^{-4}$ M$_\odot$ and 0.1 M$_\odot$
which is 67% of the source sample (with a statistical error of 33%)
with a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.81 (corresponding to a probability of 66%)

not_stated_but_needed: Solution intervals and number of channels per source for self-calibration
CLEAN mask, threshold, cell and image size
Exact fit starting parameters and which sources use point vs Gaussian in uv_fit
Weighting scheme for averaging beta and N_H2 across frequencies
Arbitrary sizes chosen for FIR1a-a and CSO33-b beyond Table values
score_reason: Data public and equations given, but imaging/self-cal parameters and some sizes are arbitrary or unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, analytic method with stated assumptions, numeric tables of results.
